title: Sacred Kashi: Spiritual Immersion & Living Heritage
tagline: 3 Days along the Sacred Ganges, Ancient Ghats & Classical Weaving Lanes

schedule.title: Subah-e-Banaras Sunrise Boat Journey
schedule.activity: Private hand-rowed wooden boat ride from Assi Ghat to Manikarnika Ghat witnessing morning prayers, classical morning ragas, and ritual ablutions in golden sunlight.
schedule.culturalNote: The morning sun hitting the centuries-old palace facades is a transformative experience documented by travelers since ancient times.
schedule.transition: 15 min gentle walk through riverside lanes to traditional breakfast halwai.
schedule.practicalTip: Carry a light shawl in winter; tea vendors on boats serve ginger chai in clay kulhad cups.

schedule.title: Traditional Banarasi Breakfast: Kachori Gali
schedule.activity: Savor piping hot Bedmi Kachori with spicy aloo subzi, fresh jalebis fried in desi ghee, and creamy malai lassi in Chowk.
schedule.culturalNote: Banarasi breakfast culture is a leisurely social ritual enjoyed by local scholars and residents alike.
schedule.transition: 10 min walk to Kashi Vishwanath Corridor.
schedule.practicalTip: Netram or Ram Bhandar are iconic century-old establishments.

schedule.title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Corridor Darshan
schedule.activity: Explore the grand marble corridor and sacred sanctum of the Jyotirlinga, admiring the gilded spire and heritage architecture.
schedule.culturalNote: Believed to be the cosmic axis of spiritual enlightenment in Vedic cosmology.
schedule.transition: Short electric rickshaw back to hotel for restful afternoon break.
schedule.practicalTip: Leave smartphones in authorized locker rooms at Gate 4.

schedule.title: Grand Dashashwamedh Ghat Ganga Aarti
schedule.activity: Reserved comfortable boat seating to witness the choreographed evening Aarti ritual with tiered brass lamps, conch shell blasts, and floating floral diyas.
schedule.culturalNote: A living Vedic ceremony that has taken place uninterrupted every single evening for generations.
schedule.transition: Return stroll to hotel or ghat-side sitar recital.
schedule.practicalTip: Reserve a center boat 1 hour before twilight for the best photographic angle.

days.theme: The Path of Enlightenment at Sarnath & Master Weavers

schedule.title: Sarnath Archaeological Park & Museum
schedule.activity: Walk among the ruins of Dhamek Stupa where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon. Visit the Museum housing the original Ashokan Lion Capital.
schedule.culturalNote: The birthplace of the Buddhist Sangha and symbol of India's philosophical renaissance under Emperor Ashoka.
schedule.transition: 25 min comfortable AC car ride back to old city.
schedule.practicalTip: Museum entry ticket includes the excavated Buddhist monastery compound.

schedule.title: Satvik Banarasi Thali Luncheon
schedule.activity: Experience an authentic Sattvic lunch prepared without onion and garlic, featuring local seasonal vegetables, lentils, and fragrant baati.
schedule.culturalNote: Culinary philosophy centered on pure flavors and digestive wellness.
schedule.transition: 10 min rickshaw ride to Madanpura craft district.
schedule.practicalTip: Try the thali at Apsara or Cantonment heritage restaurants.

schedule.title: Banarasi Silk Weaving & Heritage Craft Walk
schedule.activity: Visit traditional weaver havelis in Madanpura. Observe the intricate Jacquard loom operation and purchase authentic GI-tagged silk sarees directly from master artisans.
schedule.culturalNote: Textile craft passed down through families since the Vedic era, celebrated for pure gold zari brocade.
schedule.transition: 15 min ride to Assi Ghat.
schedule.practicalTip: Ask the weaver to explain the difference between Kadhwa and Kadiyal weaving techniques.

schedule.title: Assi Ghat Cultural Recital & Herbal Chai
schedule.activity: Listen to classical Hindustani Dhrupad vocal or sitar performance at Assi Ghat cultural stage accompanied by hot lemon-ginger herbal tea.
schedule.culturalNote: Banaras is a UNESCO City of Music, birthplace of legendary maestros like Ustad Bismillah Khan and Pandit Ravi Shankar.
schedule.transition: Evening leisure walk along the promenade.
schedule.practicalTip: Open air seating with comfortable rugs provided.

days.theme: Hidden Havelis, Sanskrit Scholars & Culinary Heritage

schedule.title: Heritage Haveli & Ancient Alleyway Walk
schedule.activity: Guided cultural walk through the hidden labyrinths of Pucca Mahal, visiting traditional wrestling akharas, ancient Sanskrit libraries, and sacred Kund water tanks.
schedule.culturalNote: The architectural layout of Kashi's galis is designed to provide natural shade and cooling throughout the seasons.
schedule.transition: Pause at Blue Lassi shop for a sweet curd refreshment.
schedule.practicalTip: Wear walking shoes with good grip on polished stone flagstones.

schedule.title: Bharat Kala Bhavan Museum (BHU Campus)
schedule.activity: Visit the university campus art museum housing rare Mughal miniature paintings, ancient Chola bronzes, and Buddhist terracotta sculptures.
schedule.culturalNote: One of India's richest university art and archaeological collections.
schedule.transition: Drive to lunch in Lanka cantonment.
schedule.practicalTip: The green tree-lined campus of Banaras Hindu University offers a restful environment.

schedule.title: Twilight Boat Cruise & Banarasi Paan Farewell
schedule.activity: Relaxing twilight boat ride across all 84 ghats from Ravidas Ghat to Rajghat. End the journey tasting the famous aromatic Maghai Banarasi Paan.
schedule.culturalNote: Paan chewing in Banaras is an art form elevated by betel leaf connoisseurs.
schedule.transition: Transfer to railway station or airport.
schedule.practicalTip: Keshav Tambool Bhandar near Lanka serves the quintessential silver-foil Banarasi paan.

title: Royal Rajasthan: Forts, Palaces & Master Crafts
tagline: 3 Days in the Pink City experiencing Amber Fortress, Astronomical Marvels & Vibrant Bazaars

days.theme: The Crown of Amer & Royal Mirror Palaces

schedule.title: Amer Fort & Sheesh Mahal Tour
schedule.activity: Explore the magnificent hilltop royal chambers of Diwan-e-Aam, Sukh Niwas, and the glittering Sheesh Mahal mirror palace overlooking Maota Lake.
schedule.culturalNote: Masterpiece of Rajput defensive architecture and Mughal-influenced court aesthetics.
schedule.transition: 15 min drive to Jal Mahal photo viewpoint.
schedule.practicalTip: Hire a government-licensed guide at the Suraj Pol gate.

schedule.title: Authentic Rajasthani Lunch: Dal Baati Churma
schedule.activity: Feast on roasted wheat baatis dipped in desi ghee, panchmel dal, spicy garlic chutney, and sweet crushed churma.
schedule.culturalNote: The quintessential royal and warrior meal of arid Rajasthan.
schedule.transition: 20 min car ride to Pink City center.
schedule.practicalTip: LMB (Laxmi Misthan Bhandar) in Johari Bazaar or 1135 AD at Amer Fort.

schedule.title: Hawa Mahal & City Palace Royal Quarters
schedule.activity: Marvel at the 953 lattice windows of Palace of Winds and stroll the royal courtyards, textiles gallery, and arms museum of the Maharaja's City Palace.
schedule.culturalNote: Jaipur was planned in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II with architect Vidyadhar Bhattacharya.
schedule.transition: Short walk into Bapu Bazaar.
schedule.practicalTip: Buy the composite entry ticket covering both Hawa Mahal and Jantar Mantar.

schedule.title: Jantar Mantar UNESCO Astronomical Observatory
schedule.activity: Witness the world's largest stone sundial (Samrat Yantra) accurate to within two seconds, and nineteen ancient astronomical architectural instruments.
schedule.culturalNote: A testament to 18th-century Indian scientific innovation and cosmic measurement.
schedule.transition: 10 min walk to Johari Bazaar gem workshops.
schedule.practicalTip: Visit in mid-morning when the sun casts sharp geometric shadows on the stone dials.

schedule.title: Block Printing & Sanganeri Craft Experience
schedule.activity: Visit artisan studio in Sanganer/Civil Lines to try hand-carved teakwood block printing with natural vegetable dyes on fine mulmul cotton.
schedule.culturalNote: Sanganeri and Bagru block prints represent centuries of community dye mastery.
schedule.transition: Drive to Nahargarh Fort for sunset.
schedule.practicalTip: Pick up genuine certified hand-block tablecloths and quilts.

schedule.title: Sunset View from Nahargarh Fort Ramparts
schedule.activity: Watch the glowing amber sunset over the entire Pink City skyline from the lofty stone battlements of Nahargarh Fort.
schedule.culturalNote: The hilltop fortification that guarded the northern defenses of the Jaipur state.
schedule.transition: Dinner in a heritage courtyard restaurant.
schedule.practicalTip: Padao open terrace cafe offers panoramic city views.

schedule.title: Panna Meena Ka Kund Stepwell & Govind Dev Ji
schedule.activity: Admire the mesmerizing symmetrical zigzag stairs of the 16th-century Panna Meena stepwell and attend morning aarti at Govind Dev Ji Temple.
schedule.culturalNote: Ancient Indian hydraulic engineering combined with sacred geometry.
schedule.transition: 15 min drive to Gaitore Royal Cenotaphs.
schedule.practicalTip: A quiet, peaceful morning destination ideal for photography.

schedule.title: Gaitore Ki Chhatriyan & Albert Hall Museum
schedule.activity: Stroll amidst delicately carved marble cenotaphs of the Kachwaha kings in a tranquil valley, followed by Indo-Saracenic Albert Hall Museum.
schedule.culturalNote: Showcases the pinnacle of Rajput stone-carving artistry under open skies.
schedule.transition: Lunch break in C-Scheme.
schedule.practicalTip: Albert Hall looks spectacularly illuminated in the evening.

schedule.title: Artisanal Bazaar Walk & Ghewar Tasting
schedule.activity: Explore the vibrant spice, lac bangle, and brassware stalls of Kishanpole and Tripolia Bazaars. Conclude tasting traditional honeycomb Ghewar.
schedule.culturalNote: Jaipur's bazaars have remained organized by guild and craft since the 18th century.
schedule.transition: Farewell transfer.
schedule.practicalTip: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar for fresh Pyaaz Kachori and Mawa Ghewar.

title: The Golden Empire: Ruins, Chariots & Sacred Boulder Hills
tagline: 2 Days across the UNESCO World Heritage monuments of the Vijayanagara Empire

days.theme: The Sacred Center & Vittala Stone Chariot

schedule.title: Vijaya Vittala Temple Complex & Stone Chariot
schedule.activity: Morning excursion to the legendary Stone Chariot and Ranga Mandapa with musical stone pillars in soft dawn light.
schedule.culturalNote: Peak of 16th-century Vijayanagara Dravidian temple craftsmanship.
schedule.transition: Short walk along the river path to King's Balance.
schedule.practicalTip: Electric cart shuttle available from parking.

schedule.title: Virupaksha Temple & Ancient Hampi Bazaar
schedule.activity: Visit the 7th-century sacred sanctum, witness temple elephant blessings, and view the ancient bazaar stone colonnades.
schedule.culturalNote: Continuously active worship site dedicated to Lord Shiva for over 1,300 years.
schedule.transition: Traditional South Indian lunch in Kamalapur.
schedule.practicalTip: Observe the pinhole camera effect in the inner sanctum wall.

schedule.title: Sunset from Hemakuta Hill & Monolithic Ganesha
schedule.activity: Gentle climb up Hemakuta Hill dotted with pre-Vijayanagara triple-chamber shrines. Watch panoramic golden sunset over boulder hills.
schedule.culturalNote: Mythological setting of the wedding of Shiva and Pampa (Parvati).
schedule.transition: Walk down to Sasivekalu Ganesha statue.
schedule.practicalTip: Wear grippy rubber-soled footwear on smooth granite slopes.

days.theme: The Royal Center & Coracle River Crossing

schedule.title: Royal Enclosure, Stepped Tank & Lotus Mahal
schedule.activity: Explore the Mahanavami Dibba platform, geometric Pushkarini stepped tank, Zenana enclosure, Lotus Mahal, and the Elephant Stables.
schedule.culturalNote: Fascinating blend of Islamic arch architecture and Hindu stonework (Indo-Islamic synthesis).
schedule.transition: Short drive to Tungabhadra riverbanks.
schedule.practicalTip: The symmetrical stepped tank has an active stone aqueduct system.

schedule.title: Traditional Banana Leaf Meals & Pomegranate Juice
schedule.activity: Enjoy piping hot rice, sambar, rasam, kootu, and coconut payasam served on fresh banana leaf.
schedule.culturalNote: Authentic North Karnataka rural cuisine with jowar rotis and spicy peanut chutneys.
schedule.transition: Transfer to Anegundi river bank.
schedule.practicalTip: Mango Tree or local family-run eateries in Kamalapura.

schedule.title: Tungabhadra Coracle Boat Ride & Anegundi Village
schedule.activity: Glide across the river in a traditional round reed coracle boat. Visit the ancient village of Anegundi and artisan banana fiber crafts.
schedule.culturalNote: Anegundi is identified with Kishkindha, the monkey kingdom in the epic Ramayana.
schedule.transition: Farewell sunset reflection.
schedule.practicalTip: Life jackets provided by licensed coracle boat operators.
